items.title: 16.2.8 Other Endocrine Glands/Tissues (printed '16.2.8.' with trailing dot) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of other endocrine glands and tissues (PDF 68-69).

blocks.text: Kai aur endocrine glands bhi hain, aur dimagh, mede, chhoti aant, jigar aur doosre aaza mein khaas endocrine cells hain.

blocks.caption: Doosre endocrine glands aur tissues
rows: thymus, sternum ke neeche phephron ke darmiyan
T cells ki pukhtagi jo jism ko jaraseem se bachate hain
pineal gland, dimagh ki tah ke qareeb
gastric glands se gastric juice chhurwata
secretin: pancreas pancreatic juice chhorta; cholecystokinin: pitta (gallbladder) bile chhorta
renin aldosterone ki paidawar qaboo karta; erythropoietin bone marrow se surkh khooni cells banwata; calcitriol aant se jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium barhata
dard ke receptors se jur kar dard ka ehsas rokte
taqatwar maqami vasodilators; sozish mein shamil

blocks.alt: Insani jism ka saada khaaka jis par endocrine glands nishan zada aur labelled hain: sar mein hypothalamus, pituitary aur pineal gland; gardan mein thyroid aur us ke peeche chaar chhote parathyroid glands; seene mein thymus; dashed gurdon ke oopar adrenal glands; pait mein pancreas; auraton ke pelvis mein ovaries; aur mardon mein pait ke bahar testes.
blocks.caption: Thymus aur pineal glands ki jagahein (Figure 16.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hypothalamus, pituitary aur pineal gland dimagh mein hain. Thyroid gardan mein trachea ke aage lipta hai, aur parathyroids us ki pichli sateh par. Thymus sternum ke neeche phephron ke darmiyan hai. Har gurde ke oopar aik adrenal gland hai. Pancreas pait mein hai. Gonads auraton mein ovaries aur mardon mein testes hain.

blocks.prompt: Kam oxygen wali bulandi par rehne wale mein kaunsa hormone barhega, aur kis uzv se?
blocks.explanation: Gurdon ka erythropoietin, jo bone marrow se zyada surkh khooni cells banwata hai. (Bulandi se is ka rabta aam biology hai, kitab mein nahi.)

items: Thymus (thymosin, T cells), pineal (melatonin, neend), aant aur meda (gastrin, secretin, cholecystokinin), gurde (renin, erythropoietin, calcitriol), dimagh (endorphins), prostaglandins.
